018package org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc;
019
020import static java.lang.String.format;
021import static java.lang.String.join;
022import static javax.tools.Diagnostic.Kind.ERROR;
023import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
024import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.EMPTY_STRING;
025import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.first;
026import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.isNotEmptyOrBlank;
027
028import javax.lang.model.element.Element;
029import java.util.ArrayList;
030import java.util.List;
031
032import org.apiguardian.api.API;
033import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.CustomTagletBase;
034import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
035import com.sun.source.doctree.DocTree;
036import com.sun.source.doctree.UnknownInlineTagTree;
037
038/**
039 *  <p>{@summary This inline tag allows to underline a sequence of text.} For
040 *  example, &quot;<code>{&#64;{@value %s #TAGLET_NAME} UNDERLINE ME}</code>&quot;
041 *  would be shown as <u>UNDERLINE ME</u>.</p>
042 *  <p>The tag does not escape HTML tags, while it will not regard most other
043 *  inline Javadoc tags.</p>
044 *  <p>The tag will not use
045 *  &quot;<code>&lt;u&gt;&hellip;&lt;/u&gt;</code>&quot; but
046 *  &quot;<code>&lt;span style='text-decoration: underline;'&gt;&hellip;&lt;/span&gt;</code>&quot;.</p>
047 *
048 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
049 *  @version $Id: UnderlineTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
050 *  @since 0.0.5
051 */
052@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: UnderlineTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
053@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.0.5" )
054public final class UnderlineTaglet extends CustomTagletBase
055{
056        /*-----------*\
057    ====** Constants **========================================================
058        \*-----------*/
059    /**
060     *  <p>{@summary The name of this taglet: {@value}.}</p>
061     */
062    public static final String TAGLET_NAME = "underline";
063
064        /*--------------*\
065    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
066        \*--------------*/
067    /**
068     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new {@code UnderlineTaglet} instance.}</p>
069     */
070    public UnderlineTaglet()
071    {
072        super( TAGLET_NAME, true, Location.values() );
073    }   //  UnderlineTaglet()
074
075        /*---------*\
076    ====** Methods **==========================================================
077        \*---------*/
078    /**
079     *  {@inheritDoc}
080     */
081    @Override
082    public final String toString( final List<? extends DocTree> tags, final Element element )
083    {
084        final List<String> buffer = new ArrayList<>();
085        for( final var tag : tags )
086        {
087            if( tag instanceof UnknownInlineTagTree inlineTagTree )
088            {
089                final var body = processTagContent( inlineTagTree.getContent(), element );
090                final var contents = processTagContent( parseText( body ), element );
091                buffer.add( isNotEmptyOrBlank( contents ) ? format( "<span style=\"text-decoration: underline;\">%1$s</span>", contents ) : EMPTY_STRING );
092            }
093            else
094            {
095                printf( ERROR, "Cannot process tag of '%s' (class '%s'): %s", tag.getKind().name(), tag.getClass().getName(), first( 20, tag.toString() ) );
096            }
097        }
098        final var retValue = join( EMPTY_STRING, buffer );
099
100        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
101        return retValue;
102    }   //  toString()
103}
104//  class UnderlineTaglet
105
